title: Toward Unmarked Doors
poem: i.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
ii.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
iii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iv.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
v.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
colophon: small marks all turned by the same unseen weather.
